units.source_text: “你总是说先生先生的，到底是谁呀？”哥哥问我。

en.t: "You are always saying 'Sensei, Sensei.' Who on earth is he?" my elder brother asked me.

units.source_text: “前几天不是跟你说过了吗？”我回答。

en.t: "Didn't I tell you about him the other day?" I answered.

units.source_text: 对哥哥老是这样，问过别人的话随后就忘掉的毛病，我心生不快。

en.t: I felt displeased with my elder brother's old habit of asking people things and then soon forgetting what they had said.
"I did hear you tell me about him, but..."

units.source_text: 他的意思是，虽然听我说过，可还是不甚明了。

en.t: What he meant was that although he had heard me speak of Sensei, he still did not really understand.

units.source_text: 我觉得没有必要非得让哥哥理解先生。

en.t: I did not think it was necessary to make my elder brother understand Sensei.

units.source_text: 可是哥哥竟生了我的气，我觉得哥哥的老毛病又犯了。

en.t: But my elder brother actually became angry with me, and I felt that his old habit had shown itself again.

units.source_text: 在哥哥看来，既然我那么尊敬地一口一个先生地叫，想必是个知名人士，至少也该是位大学教授吧。

en.t: From my elder brother's point of view, since I called him Sensei with such respect over and over, he must surely be a well-known person, at least a university professor.

units.source_text: 既没有名气，又什么都不做的人，有什么地方值得尊敬呢？

en.t: What was there to respect in someone who had no reputation and did nothing at all?

units.source_text: 在这一点上，哥哥的心思同父亲完全一样。

en.t: On this point, my elder brother's thinking was exactly the same as my father's.

units.source_text: 不同的是，父亲轻率地断定先生是因为没有本事才游手好闲的；

en.t: The difference was that my father rashly concluded that Sensei was idle because he had no ability;

units.source_text: 相反，听哥哥的口气，似乎是说先生虽有才干，却游手好闲，因而不过是个没出息的人。

en.t: By contrast, from my elder brother's tone, he seemed to be saying that Sensei had talent but idled his life away, and was therefore nothing more than a worthless man.

units.source_text: “这么egoist可不好，无所事事地活着，是懒汉哲学。

en.t: "Being such an egoist is no good. Living without doing anything is a lazy man's philosophy.

units.source_text: 人活着，就一定要最大限度地发挥自己的才能。”

en.t: As long as a person is alive, he must make the fullest use of his own abilities."

units.source_text: 我真想反问哥哥一句，你懂不懂自己说的egoist这个词的意思啊？

en.t: I really wanted to ask my elder brother in return whether he understood the meaning of the word egoist he himself was using.

units.source_text: “不过，如果你能靠他谋到个好差事，还算不错。

en.t: "Still, if you can get a good position through him, that would not be bad.

units.source_text: 爸爸不是也很高兴吗？”后来哥哥又这样说。

en.t: Father would be pleased too, wouldn't he?" my elder brother later said.
